changes.title: Upcoming invoice endpoints replaced by Create Preview Invoice
changes.description: The Invoice.upcoming() and InvoiceLineItem.list(invoice='upcoming') methods were removed in API version 2025-03-31.basil. They are replaced by Invoice.create_preview(), which returns the same preview invoice object; its line items are paginated via InvoiceLineItem.list on the returned preview.

detect.notes: Parameters largely carry over: customer, subscription, subscription_items map to the same names on create_preview; subscription_* flat params moved under subscription_details in basil.

replace.guidance: Replace stripe.Invoice.upcoming(params) with stripe.Invoice.create_preview(params). Move subscription_items and subscription_proration_date style params under subscription_details={'items': ..., 'proration_date': ...}. For listing upcoming line items, create the preview first, then use InvoiceLineItem.list(invoice=preview.id).

changes.title: Subscription current_period_start/end moved to subscription items
changes.description: In 2025-03-31.basil, the current_period_start and current_period_end attributes were removed from the Subscription resource. Billing periods are now tracked per subscription item: subscription['items']['data'][i]['current_period_start'] / subscription.items.data[i].current_period_end.

detect.notes: Only flag reads from a Subscription object; reads already on items.data[...] are the NEW pattern and must not be rewritten.

replace.guidance: Replace subscription.current_period_end (or subscription['current_period_end']) with subscription.items.data[0].current_period_end (or subscription['items']['data'][0]['current_period_end']) for single-item subscriptions. For multi-item subscriptions, compute the relevant item's period. Ensure the subscription fetch expands items.

changes.title: stripe.api_key global assignment replaced by StripeClient
changes.description: The global stripe.api_key = 'sk_...' pattern and module-level methods like stripe.Charge.create() are deprecated. Use the instance-based StripeClient pattern: client = stripe.StripeClient('sk_...') then client.charges.create().

detect.notes: The StripeClient pattern supports per-request API keys and is thread-safe. Detect both the api_key assignment and direct module-level resource access.

replace.guidance: Replace 'stripe.api_key = key' + 'stripe.Charge.create(...)' with 'client = stripe.StripeClient(key)' + 'client.charges.create(...)'. The resource names change from PascalCase class methods to snake_case client attributes: Charge->charges, Customer->customers, PaymentIntent->payment_intents, etc. Keep the StripeClient instantiation near the top of the module or in a factory function.
